title: ZeniMax Workers United-CWA: bargained AI notice and impact rights

observations.claim: CWA published bargaining principles that prioritize accountability, proactive bargaining and early meaningful worker voice over workplace AI.
limits: Bounded to the cited public record and instrument posture.

observations.claim: CWA reported that 376 ZeniMax workers obtained a legally binding tentative agreement governing workplace AI adoption.
limits: Bounded to the cited public record and instrument posture.

observations.claim: The public summary states that ZeniMax must notify the union when AI implementation may affect represented work and bargain those impacts upon request.
limits: Bounded to the cited public record and instrument posture.

observations.claim: The agreement publicly names fairness, reliability and safety, privacy and security, inclusion, transparency and accountability as guiding principles.
limits: Bounded to the cited public record and instrument posture.

observations.claim: A separate neutrality agreement preserves worker-union communication and includes dispute resolution and arbitration, enabling the collective actor that negotiated the AI agreement.
limits: Bounded to the cited public record and instrument posture.

observations.claim: A later first-contract announcement recovers continued bargaining and contract formation but does not publish the final AI clause text.
limits: Bounded to the cited public record and instrument posture.

findings.claim: Collective bargaining can place worker voice before AI implementation rather than limiting review to a post-harm individual appeal.
limits: No unpublished term, universal prevalence, named-company intent, or complete worker outcome is inferred.

findings.claim: The public agreement summary recovers notice and bargaining over impacts, but not a general union veto, automatic pause, worker-level explanation, or system-revision audit.
limits: No unpublished term, universal prevalence, named-company intent, or complete worker outcome is inferred.

findings.claim: Neutrality and organizing access are part of the counterpower mechanism because a bargaining right is inert where workers cannot form or maintain the representative body.
limits: No unpublished term, universal prevalence, named-company intent, or complete worker outcome is inferred.

findings.claim: No named AI deployment, grievance result, override, restoration, or survivor-bias reconciliation is publicly recovered for this lane.
limits: No unpublished term, universal prevalence, named-company intent, or complete worker outcome is inferred.
